note: The numbered messages of the firm that the two texts in this folder answer. S1 is the offer of the Larkmere docket of Monday, June 10 to Maya Venn (messages 1 to 5 of the packet). S2 is the day-before text for the Fenwick Vale docket of Thursday, June 6, sent on Wednesday, June 5 at 8:00 a.m. (message 41 of the packet answers it). The times follow data/timeline.json, which is simulated. "hearings" lists the hearings of the docket in order, so that number 1 is the first.
